registration.server: AddLatticeMcp registers the streamable-HTTP MCP server and installs per-session permission-scoped tool discovery.
registration.endpoint: MapLatticeMcp maps the MCP transport at LatticeApiMcpOptions.TransportPattern and applies RequireAuthorization by default.
registration.authorization_gate: CredentialStampingTool enforces ILatticeApiMcpAuthorizer at invocation, stamps caller credentials and active tenant, resolves optional region, and translates faults.
registration.write_opt_in: Mutating tool modules are contributed only by their enableWrites, enableControl, enableAdministration, enableSchemaControl, enableLifecycle, or equivalent opt-in flags.
registration.region_parameter: CredentialStampingTool advertises an optional region string on facade-backed tools and rejects unknown or unreachable targets fail-closed.

grpc.marshalling: MCP tools are structured JSON over streamable HTTP; remote facade routing may use gRPC behind the MCP binding but no MCP operation is itself a gRPC method.

request.name: targetTreeId
request.notes: The tree to restore into; null restores into the captured tree.

request.name: mode
request.notes: Restore mode. InPlace (default): an HLC-preserving last-writer-wins merge into the live tree that heals missing or stale entries (a captured entry wins only when its clock is newer than, or the key is absent from, the live tree) and therefore never overwrites data that is newer live - it is a convergent repair, NOT a rollback. ShadowCutover: rebuilds the scope into a fresh physical tree and atomically swaps it in, a wholesale point-in-time replacement (true rollback) that is reversible via lattice_backup_revert_restore.

request.name: ttlSeconds
request.notes: An optional explicit time-to-live in seconds. When omitted, a newly created entry uses the repository's default memory TTL (if configured), otherwise it is durable.

request.name: leaseSeconds
request.notes: The lease length to request in seconds. Always pass this explicitly. Omitting it defers to the same deliberately short cluster default as a claim (30 seconds unless the host overrides it), so a renew that omits it SHORTENS a claim currently held for longer - and still reports 'granted: true', with the loss surfacing only on the next renew as 'superseded'. A renew that shortens its lease is flagged in 'leaseShortened'. The lock clamps any request to the configured maximum; act on the returned 'leaseSeconds' and 'leaseExpiresAtUtc', never on the value you asked for.
